svg.text: DynaHist: port a histogram library from Java to Go
The agent gets the Java library and a Go package whose functions are stubs with their final signatures. It fills in every body so the Go code returns exactly what the
Java code returns, then the library's own tests, ported to Go and kept hidden, score the port.
add, merge, rank and quantile queries
SciPy quantile and value estimators, bit-level I/O
and varints, interpolation and search helpers
plus the Layout and Histogram interfaces with
diffs signatures against the stubs, runs go build
and go vet, flags name clashes with test helpers
no os, net, unsafe, syscall, cgo or embed; RE2
regular expressions only; 2 vCPUs, 60 s and 2 GB
weighted share of tests passed; a test that
WHAT THE GO CODE MUST REPRODUCE, STAGE BY STAGE
a value goes into a bin, counts are stored compactly, quantiles are read back and the histogram is written to bytes; each step must match the Java output exactly
bin widths stay within an absolute
the index range widens, and counts
plus a value policy inside the bin
the bytes must equal what the Java
